task_desc: Test the guard hook's hash mismatch check. A verified experiment is required to write code, but if the experiment record covers a different file glob, permission must be denied. Scope matching is mandatory.
Stop hook timeout behavior. If the story file is deleted or corrupted while the stop hook is running, it must handle the error and not lock the session. Test graceful degradation.
Consistency between the QR record and the PR record. If all DoDs pass in the QR, the PR must automatically be READY. If the QR is partial, the PR must be PENDING.
Commit message format validation. All experiment-based commits must follow a standard format: the 'Add <feature> (E-NNN) — <claim>' title, a measured value, and the GATE-OK token.
Mode selection experiment. Design a system that automatically classifies whether a task is Mode A (code) or Mode C (design). The misclassification rate must be < 10%.
SkillOpt training pipeline error handling. When the model API returns 404, training must not fail silently; it must write to the error log and retry with a cooldown.
Seed determinism test. When training is run twice with the same seed, the rollout scores of the first 3 steps must be identical (seed-controlled randomness even if the model is not deterministic).
Regression guard test. When trying to write code with an old experiment record (if the record has already reached a decision and is closed), the guard hook must request a new experiment.
